title: The first law: where 500 J of heat goes
caption: The gas absorbs Q = 500 J. Of it, W = 200 J leaves as work done by the gas and the other ΔU = Q − W = +300 J stays as internal energy. Energy is conserved: the two outputs add up to the heat put in.
alt: Energy flow: 500 J of heat in splits into 200 J of work done by the gas and 300 J of increased internal energy.
description: 500 J of heat flows into the gas.
200 J leaves as work done by the gas on its surroundings.
ΔU = 500 − 200 = +300 J remains in the gas as internal energy, so its temperature rises.
